tasks.label: Audit generated build artifacts
args: Get-PSDrive C | Select-Object Name,Free,Used; $paths = @('build','android\build','android\app\build','.dart_tool'); foreach ($item in $paths) { if (Test-Path $item) { $size = (Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $item -Recurse -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object -Property Length -Sum).Sum; [PSCustomObject]@{Path=$item; Bytes=$size} } }
